name: agent-watch
description: A live pane of what every agent in the session is working on right now.

autoOpenWindow.title: Open the agents window by itself
autoOpenWindow.description: Opens the agents window in a browser the first time two or more agents are working in a session. Off, the window opens only when you type /agent-watch gui.

narrator.title: Plain-words narrator in the agents window
narrator.description: While the agents window is open, a small model (Haiku) writes each agent's card in plain words at the moments that matter: at most one call per agent per 20 s and 80 calls a session, its cost shown at the foot of the window. Off, the cards use plain rules and no model is called.
